capabilities: Navigate pages via a Codex-style sidebar
Aggregate unfinished tasks into a reminders page
Render compact Bases tables with colored tags and covers
Edit records inline with database undo/redo
Toggle enhanced and native Obsidian appearance
disambiguation: Not a focus timer or distraction-free writing mode; it reworks page navigation, reminders, and Bases table views.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.5 or later; targets macOS desktop and iPhone only (Android, iPad and third-party themes unvalidated). No telemetry or network server; optional AI recording sends data to a user-configured API only when sending. Some Bases enhancements depend on internal view structures and fall back to native controls. GPL-3.0-only with a bundled LXGW WenKai font (SIL OFL).
intentEvidence: Configured tables support linked record titles, colored tags, content-driven row heights, compact thumbnails and linked records.
problem: Navigating and editing local Markdown notes and Bases lacks a focused, compact workspace with clear page navigation and Notion-like table views.

relations.evidence: Disable the old native-reading-ui development plugin first if present; transfer its data.json
The project initially borrowed from Notion's database presentation
Its navigation and typography take cues from Codex
the mobile sidebar follows ChatGPT's restrained layout

requires.name: OpenAI, DeepSeek, or compatible API for AI recording

summary: Workspace plugin that adds a Codex-style page sidebar, reminders, and Notion-like compact Bases tables with colored tags and inline editing.
